name: "F'n Show" Tony Monroe
notes: Known from one post to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy (3 December 2000), served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/the-raid-on-flora-street-rp-2000-12-03.html: 'F'n Show', the Ace who calls himself the Ace of Clubs, clubs Don Barnetto across the back with an iron club during the A.C.E. raid on Flora Street; the WIW's own cards of 14 November 2000 bill him '"F'n Show" Tony Monroe'.
caption: A World Internet Wrestling Ace who called himself the Ace of Clubs and clubbed a mafia don in a Four Aces roleplay of December 2000.

tenures.source: /promotions/wiw-geocities-2000/archive/wiw-shockwave-2000-11-14.html ('Justin Blake vs "F'n Show" Tony Monroe'); /promotions/wiw-geocities-2000/archive/wiw-tuesday-night-turmoil-2000-11-14.html (Acid Rain + Tony Monroe); the roleplay of 3 December 2000

name: Acid
notes: Known from one post to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy (3 December 2000), served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/the-raid-on-flora-street-rp-2000-12-03.html: Acid, the Ace from London ('I sure don't get such action back in London'), helps carry Skiller out of Don Barnetto's house after the shooting.
caption: A London-born Ace of the World Internet Wrestling's Four Aces, on the A.C.E. raid on Flora Street, December 2000.

tenures.source: the roleplay of 3 December 2000 (by 'Drastic' O. Skiller, from The Four Aces stable, WIW)
